clauses.quoted_text: Buyer is responsible for all sales, use, and excise taxes arising from its purchases. Unit prices stated in each Order are firm for the term of the Order.
clauses.reasoning: Section 4 (Taxes) allocates sales, use, and excise taxes to the Buyer but does not mention tariffs, duties, surcharges, or refunds. Nothing in the agreement requires any refund of tariffs to the Buyer.
